page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each of the 64 vCPUs maps directly to a dedicated physical core, ensuring consistent compute performance without resource sharing at the thread level.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps, facilitating reliable data transfer rates for distributed environments.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g5.16xlarge offers a balanced resource profile suitable for enterprise workloads that require high CPU core density and dedicated compute resources without the premium cost of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. This configuration is well-suited for general-purpose workloads, including medium-to-large databases, enterprise application servers, web serving fleets, and containerized microservices.
